title: Round 14, stage 2: every cell continues on net1 v6
description: Round 14 (exp-net2-r14-v6-154: recurrent PPO from net1 v6's rule, the flow alone on about half the training links, 30 s episodes, tau 1 s and 5 s, seeds 1 to 3) ended while its cells were still improving: the first cell to finish (tau 5 s, seed 1) went from -0.273 at iteration 39 to +0.012 at its last, with +0.078 against competitors and -0.055 where the flow is alone. Stage 2 continues every cell from its final actor and critic (release model-net2-r14-state) with everything else unchanged, 120 more iterations, training seed + 100. Validation links only; checkpoints are chosen on validation and the gate runs after the last stage.
prepare: (cd "$IN/a" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_setup.py "$OUT/setup" --net1 "$N" --models "$IN/models" --u 0.25 --paths net2-train-xl
run: S="$OUT/spec-r14s2-tau$TAU-s$SEED.json"; A="$IN/a/ppo-r14-tau$TAU-s$SEED"; jq --argjson tau "$TAU" --argjson seed "$SEED" --arg actor "$A.actor.pt" --arg critic "$A.critic.pt" '.algo = "ppo" | .base = "fixed" | .copies_reward = "team" | .critic_flows = true | .noise_sigma = 0.2 | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .tau_s = $tau | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .lr = 0.0003 | .alone = 0.4 | .compete = 0.4 | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .seed = ($seed + 100) | .iterations = 120 | .eval_every = 20 | .init_actor = $actor | .init_critic = $critic' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r14s2-tau$TAU-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
